actions.description: Run the native calibration procedure for a calibration type

inputs.description: Calibration type passed to the native procedure
inputs.name: calibration_type

actions.name: calibrate

outputs.description: Calibration response document returned by the instrument
outputs.name: response

actions.description: Start a method and remember its id for the stop path
actions.name: start_method

outputs.description: Start response document returned by the instrument
outputs.name: response

actions.description: Stop the method with the given id and remember it for the safe-state action
actions.name: stop_method

outputs.description: Stop response document returned by the instrument
outputs.name: response

actions.description: Stop the tracked method (the safe state); it takes no input
actions.name: stop_active_method

outputs.description: True when a tracked method was stopped
outputs.name: stopped

outputs.description: Method id that was stopped; empty without a tracked method
outputs.name: method_id

facts.text: The client sends JSON over HTTP to a base URL and authenticates with a bearer API key or HTTP basic credentials
get_instrument_status reads GET /api/v1/status and get_available_apps reads GET /api/v1/apps
start_method posts /api/v1/methods/start with a method_id and an optional plate_config
get_method_status reads GET /api/v1/methods/{method_id}/status and stop_method posts to /api/v1/methods/{method_id}/stop
get_instrument_settings reads GET /api/v1/settings and get_plate_geometry reads GET /api/v1/plate-geometry
calibrate_instrument posts /api/v1/calibrate with a calibration type
A method strip can be an injection with a volume in microliters and a speed in microliters per second
A shaking strip takes a duration in seconds, a frequency in rpm and an amplitude in mm
The measurement parameters carry an optional temperature
The supported plate types are 96-well, 384-well and 1536-well microplates and a cell chip
The scripts target SparkControl V2.4 (Document Part No. 30245640)

measures.description: Status document returned by the instrument

measures.description: Applications document returned by the instrument
measures.name: available_apps

measures.description: Instrument settings document returned by the instrument
measures.name: instrument_settings

safe_state.description: the tracked method is stopped with the native stop_method; without a tracked method the driver only queries the instrument status, because the client has no global stop request
